diagnosis.secondaryMisattachment: Defuddle body presentation space after SUP makes combineLiteralPowers() consider four prior numeric measurements as bases; its adjacent-character isotope guard is insufficient for this actual conversion.
diagnosis.classification: Existing implementation bug for missing prefix role; read-only historical replay proves #48 pass participates in four added backward measurement bindings. It does not prove earlier isotope conversion was correct.
